description: Source code for CID-keyed Type1 font loader in the FreeType project, including functions for parsing font dictionaries, loading font matrices, reading subroutines, and converting hex to binary.

methods.name: cid_get_offset
methods.description: Reads a single offset value from a byte stream based on the specified size.

methods.name: cid_load_keyword
methods.description: Loads a font dictionary keyword into the font face structure.

methods.name: cid_parse_font_matrix
methods.description: Parses and sets the font matrix and offset for CID fonts.

methods.name: parse_fd_array
methods.description: Parses the Font Dictionary array from the font data.

methods.name: parse_expansion_factor
methods.description: Parses and sets the expansion factor for font dictionaries.

methods.name: cid_parse_dict
methods.description: Parses a font dictionary from the font data stream.

methods.name: cid_read_subrs
methods.description: Reads and decrypts subroutines for CID fonts.

methods.name: cid_done_loader
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the CID loader.

methods.name: cid_hex_to_binary
methods.description: Converts hexadecimal font data to binary format.

methods.name: cid_face_open
methods.description: Main function to open and parse a CID font face from a stream.
